BiblicalUsage: Aryeh is named once, as one of the men slain with Pekahiah the son of Menahem when Pekah conspired against him in Samaria. He is named with Argob, and nothing more is said of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A man named only to die with his king tells me how close the king's men stood to him, and how suddenly a conspiracy ends them all.
